remarks: Welcome to this impeccably maintained, beautifully styled and renovated Connecticut coastal home located in the sought-after Marvin Beach Association! Perfectly blending classic charm with modern updates, this home features a spacious, sun-filled layout ideal for comfortable living and entertaining. Step inside to discover the large living room, leading to the terrific dining room with cozy built in bench, providing extra storage and the fantastic, custom kitchen with contemporary finishes including Thermador appliances, Perrin & Rowe bridge faucet, Rohl Shaw farm sink and honed quartz counters. Enjoy morning coffee on the inviting front porch, or unwind in the private backyard oasis, with large patio and beautiful landscaping, perfect for outdoor gatherings! Upstairs, you will find an elegantly finished full bathroom, primary bedroom with spacious custom closets and millwork, two guest bedrooms and a 4th room, currently used as an office, but could be a nursery or 4th bedroom, all offering a wonderful, bright, beach home feeling! Nestled in a welcoming coastal community, this home offers not just comfort, but the lifestyle of The Marvin Beach Association, with 3 private beaches, a private marina and lots of social activities throughout the year! An amazing place to call home!!
